summary: Wind turbine operations often involve high numbers of alarms during fault events, requiring significant effort to identify root causes and downtime periods. This library automates stoppage and fault period identification, assigning a high-level "stoppage category" to each event. It also provides functionality to label SCADA data for predictive maintenance algorithms. The library aims to be an open-source alternative for the research community, facilitating easier fault detection and prognostics in wind turbines. This contributes to improved reliability and efficiency in the wind energy sector. The library's focus is on wind turbine operations, primarily benefiting the wind energy industry.
